parties: BOW 40 - Tata Patagonia - Ramiro Clemente Diaz
procedural_matters: ARG 5453 (Bow 40) was represented by Ramiro Clemente Diaz.
Race Committee was represented by Sean Semmens.
Valentin Campero (trimmer on ARG 5453) gave evidence as a witness for ARG 5453.
David Rollinson (Deputy Race Officer) gave evidence as a witness for the race committee.
David Rollinson (Deputy Race Officer) provided video evidence.
facts: In race 3 black flag was displayed as the preparatory signal.
Just before the start, the race committee identified ARG 5453's (Bow 40) hull in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark.
ARG 5453 was scored BFD in race 3.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
